title: Wire explicit client subscription and schedule uploads
acceptance_criteria: Pairing and subscription upload remain behind an explicit user action after notification permission is granted; no upload occurs on page load or from an unrelated background effect.

The client projects only the reminder enabled state, configured local time, detected IANA timezone, and matching weekday mask to the API; exercises, routines, routine ids, and generated sessions never leave the device.

Changing reminder settings or weekly assignments updates the remote schedule when credentials exist, while local persistence and foreground reminder fallback continue to work when the API is unavailable.
Existing subscriptions are reused, registration can be retried, and UI feedback distinguishes unconfigured, unauthorized, offline, and successful states without displaying tokens.
Client component, projection, and integration tests pass without changing exercise or routine behavior.
completion_summary: Explicit pairing/push registration, four-field schedule projection, credential-aware remote sync, safe status feedback, and focused tests. Web tests, lint, and build pass.
